21ninja.definition: Daily reachable endpoints measured by 21 Ninja p2p-crawler; date-only observation window.
21ninja.independence: Independent crawler implementation (virtu/p2p-crawler); discovery upstream may overlap.
limitations: Latest available CSV row may be historical. No endpoint list or successful filter-response metric in this series.

21ninja_seeds.definition: Retained seed-export records with per-endpoint last-success times and exporter good flags; not a simultaneous reachable census.
21ninja_seeds.independence: 21 Ninja seed export; same project as the CSV series, not an additional independent observer.
limitations: Export creation time is not the observation time. Retention window and good-flag policy require upstream clarification.
I2P port-zero records retain their source representation and are not wallet dial candidates.

21ninja_services.definition: Daily reachable endpoints measured by 21 Ninja p2p-crawler; date-only observation window.
21ninja_services.independence: Same 21 Ninja observation series; not another independent source.
limitations: Latest available CSV row may be historical. No endpoint list or successful filter-response metric in this series.

bitnodes.definition: Endpoint dashboard retaining unresponsive endpoints for eight days; discovery hourly.
bitnodes.independence: Separate published dashboard; shared Bitnodes crawler lineage, upstream observation independence unconfirmed.
limitations: Exact observation window unavailable. No endpoint export captured.
Displayed protocol coverage is IPv4, IPv6 and Tor; I2P measurement unavailable.
Software table includes grouped rows; no unverified summation of overlapping groups.

btcnodes.definition: Reachable endpoint snapshot (address and port), with advertised version service bits.
btcnodes.independence: Winnow input source; shared endpoint data. BTCNodes and Bitnod.es link to related crawler software; observation independence is unconfirmed.
limitations: Snapshot timestamp is available; complete scan start/end and retry window may differ. Advertised services do not prove filter responses.

coindance.definition: Public listening nodes deduplicated by address, rather than address and port.
coindance.independence: Separate dashboard; implementation and upstream observation independence unconfirmed.
limitations: Exact scan window and overlay coverage unavailable; relative page freshness is not a precise scan timestamp.
No endpoint export captured. Address-deduplicated denominator differs from Winnow.

winnow.definition: New Winnow attempts against supported BTCNodes input endpoints. Version responses and successful compact-filter handshakes are distinct stages.
winnow.independence: Winnow observation, with BTCNodes input endpoints.
limitations: No successful compact-filter response test in the census handshake.
